df -h /root/autodl-tmp/
```

- exp_id: sft_qwen_math_standard_20_v2, project: recovery_aware_struct_prune

- 然后 field: status, value: DONE

```bash
echo "=== CKA-only optimizer files ==="
find /root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_qwen_math_cka_only_20/ -name "optimizer.pt" -exec ls -lh {} \;

```bash
find /root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_qwen_math_cka_only_20/ -name "optimizer.pt" -delete
find /root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_standard_20_qwen_math/ -name "optimizer.pt" -delete
echo "=== Disk after cleanup ==="
df -h /root/autodl-tmp/
```

同时也删除 v2 的输出目录（如果存在但不完整）：
```bash
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_standard_20_qwen_math_final/ 2>/dev/null && echo "EXISTS" || echo "NOT_FOUND"
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_qwen_math_cka_only_20_final/ 2>/dev/null && echo "EXISTS" || echo "NOT_FOUND"
```
不要删除 _final 目录——CKA-only v2 已成功完成，_final 目录里有有效模型。

ssh_execute（account=root）：

```bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

echo "=== Standard checkpoint-935 ==="
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_standard_20_qwen_math/checkpoint-935/model.safetensors
python3 -c "
from safetensors import safe_open
f = safe_open('/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_standard_20_qwen_math/checkpoint-935/model.safetensors', framework='pt')
print(f'Standard OK: {len(f.keys())} tensors')
"

echo "=== CKA-only checkpoint-935 ==="
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_qwen_math_cka_only_20/checkpoint-935/model.safetensors
python3 -c "
from safetensors import safe_open
f = safe_open('/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_qwen_math_cka_only_20/checkpoint-935/model.safetensors', framework='pt')

  project="recovery_aware_struct_prune",
  timeout_hours=4,
  command='bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune && python src/eval_gsm8k.py --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_standard_20_qwen_math/checkpoint-935 --max_samples 200 --gpu 0"'

- 不要提交 eval
